retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the Social Democrat leadership election of 11 January 2020, at which Rui Rio was returned. The atlas keeps a party's internal election where something in the atlas follows from it — the ballot of November 2021 is kept because it chose the candidate for the election of January 2022, and that of May 2022 because it chose the prime minister of April 2024. Nothing in the atlas follows from this one.
